# The case

Two printed parts and a knob. Print them before you start wiring.

## Files

| File | Qty | What it is | Print |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stl/box.stl` | 1 | The box: holds the board on four posts | PETG, upright, no supports |
| `stl/lid.stl` | 1 | The lid, screwed on with four M3 | PETG, as it lies, no supports |
| `knob.3mf` | 2 | The knob for the pot | Clear PETG, no supports |
| `stl/long-rail.stl` | 1 | A DIN rail clip, too long for most printers on purpose | PLA, on its side, supports on |
| `stl/tall-post.stl` | 4 | A tall stand-off post | same |
| `stl/foot.stl` | 4 | A rubbery foot, missing on purpose | TPU |

## Putting it together

1. Press the four M3 inserts into the box's posts.
2. Screw the board onto the posts.
3. Fit the lid.
